scope.input_relation_scope: prepared snapshots only; first-occurrence edges, historical product reports and historical problem inventory
scope.checkpoint_score_coverage: all prediction rows in each fully scanned quarter; deterministic sample: none

tolerance.integers: exact; booleans are not accepted as integers
tolerance.candidate_lists_and_hashes: exact; SHA-256 over compact UTF-8 JSON list, ensure_ascii=False

selection_lock_order.basis: Linux filesystem birth timestamps for trace creation plus trace fit_started event; test trace creation follows selection lock, and test_2025 trace creation follows test_2024 trace completion. Trace rows themselves have no absolute timestamps.

evidence.aggregation: quarter ranks -> integer hit numerators / positive-edge denominators, per-product recalls and reciprocal-rank sums, then additive raw accumulators across quarters and years; aggregate is not a mean of annual recalls

metric_denominator_contract.micro_recall: sum hits_at_k divided by sum eligible positive edges
metric_denominator_contract.macro_recall_and_mrr: sum of per-product recall or reciprocal rank divided by contributing positive-containing products
metric_denominator_contract.multi_quarter_aggregate: sum raw integer numerators and denominators across quarters/years before division; no average of phase recalls

evidence.score_reconstruction: GraphSageRanker.from_checkpoint from each of six serialized checkpoints; every candidate prediction score and the complete rank order checked
